label: preparing
what: Innkeeper and local tradespeople are coordinating a great-hall meeting and presentation for day 1 at 18:00, with advance preparation access and a request that the mayor arrive precisely on time. Freight discussed committee preparations privately with the innkeeper; builder is coordinating attendance. Secretary knowingly assists with scheduling, confirmation and room access, but is not shown to know the concealed content. The presentation's details remain undisclosed; a forty-year-service anniversary surprise is plausible but unconfirmed.
